contracts.summary: With the flag-gated client-request panel, staff record which deterministically parsed proposals were staged from one exact customer change request through a callable-only, create-only, replay-stable attestation that the server binds to the exact stored request identity and message hash, the acting staff member, and the quote revision at record time; the record never replies to the customer, mutates the quote, portal, or versions, and browser writes are rules-denied. A second, later callable performs the record's only permitted follow-up mutation: a bounded, write-once link from the record to the quote version that resulted from actually saving the staged edits, completing the intent-to-version audit trail. Linking is fired best-effort right after a save that already fully succeeded on its own; it never blocks, never surfaces its own failure, and never overwrites an existing link to a different version — only idempotent replay of the same one.
